sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 16 October 2026, pitch SYN-SYNCP000066-P1 was put before Northstar Urgent Care 066 on behalf of PFIZER.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a group service charge of 2.25 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a Pneumococcal preferred-position minimum of 45 per cent in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer signed off on the terms.
